title: Acceleration calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the acceleration as 2 m/s² using the displacement difference over equal time intervals.

title: Velocity at point B
description: Important: The response must determine the instantaneous velocity at B (8 m/s) using the average velocity over AC or a correct kinematic relation.

title: Distance above A
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the minimum length of the incline above point A as 4 m, using kinematics from rest to point B.

title: Apply Δx = aT²
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula for displacement difference in consecutive equal time intervals (BC - AB = aT²).

title: Kinematic consistency
description: Optional: The response shows unit analysis or verifies consistency among velocity, acceleration, and displacement equations.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if acceleration sign is wrong, units are missing/incorrect, or displacement values are misassigned (e.g., swapping AB and BC).

title: Misinterpret time intervals
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the time intervals for AB and BC are not treated as equal (2 s each) or if total time for AC is misused.
